issues.description: The specification/UML requires `SealSaloon.checkOrderReady()` with no parameters, but the solution defines `checkOrderReady(boolean enableLogging)` and `orderMeal(...)` calls it with a boolean. Tests or student implementations following the spec will not match this API.
issues.suggestedFix: Implement the required public `void checkOrderReady()` with no parameters (and have it contain the logic). If keeping logging control, make `checkOrderReady(boolean)` private and have the no-arg method delegate to it.

issues.description: The text first specifies `SealSaloon` should have an instance field `final Stock stock`, but later explicitly requires the `stock` attribute to be static/shared across all instances. These two requirements (instance-final vs. static class field) contradict each other and can mislead students about the intended field declaration.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the specification consistent by choosing one model. If stock must be shared (as stated later and as in the solution), specify `private static final Stock stock` everywhere (including UML/text) and remove the earlier 'final Stock stock' instance-field wording.
